[[File:Veofum.png|thumb|250px|Veofum]] '''Veofum''' (Japanese: '''ベオラム''' ''Beoram'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XYS05|The Legend of X, Y, and Z!]]''. Veofum was a selfish, ruthless, and greedy king who wanted the power of {{p|Xerneas}} so he could bring prosperity to his land. However, instead of flourishing it, the plant life in his kingdom wilted and the Pokémon began dying. Angered at this, he ordered his men to burn Xerneas. {{OBP|Jan|XYS05}} arrived and tried to stop Veofum from burning Xerneas, but he refused. Veofum ordered his men to get rid of Jan, when suddenly, the Legendary Pokémon {{p|Zygarde}} appeared. Zygarde used {{m|Land's Wrath}} to destroy the kingdom, which led to the demise of Veofum and his henchmen. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fairy color}}|bordercolor={{fairy color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |fi=Arto Nieminen |it=Gianluca Iacono |es_eu=Miguel Ángel Muro |pl=Wojciech Chorąży}}
